extracted.name: 3-Ingredient Shortbread Cookies
extracted.description: These melt in your mouth. The secret is in the beating.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C.)
Combine butter or margarine, flour, and confectioners' sugar; beat for 10 minutes.
Drop spoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate with maraschino cherry pieces.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until bottoms are lightly browned.
